newsitem.title: USA: Tambrands awards $65 million Tampax ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Tambrands awards $65 million Tampax ad campaign.

text.p: Tambrands Inc. said Monday it selected Foote, Cone & Belding to handle a planned $65 million annual advertising campaign to promote its Tampax tampons around the world.
Tambrands said the unit of True North Communications Inc. will handle creative development for the Tampax brand worldwide, including new product initiatives.
"We are very excited by the compelling work FCB presented which showed they really understand our consumers," Tom Mason, Tambrands' chief operating officer, said in a statement.

"They developed a global campaign idea that will get all women to listen to our message, whether they are lifelong tampon users in America or brand new to the product category in Asia and Latin America.

"This is crucial to our goal of growing the tampon category and the Tampax brand around the world," added Mason, who became chief operating officer last month as part of the company's reorganization to support Tampax's worldwide growth.
Mason said the new Tampax global advertising campaign is expected to begin airing in several markets early next year.
Tampax tampons, which have been manufactured for 60 years, are the worldwide market leader, selling in more than 150 countries.

The company, based in White Plains, N.Y., said its potential for long-term growth was extraordinary. It said only one in 15 menstruating women in the world currently uses tampons while competing pads have a 75 percent share of the $8 billion global market.
Tambrands said the New York firm Batten Barton Durstine Osborn, which had the Tampax advertising contract for the past five years, was one of three agencies that vied for the new contract.
"We had three talented agencies vying for our business and saw great ideas from all of them," Mason said.
Tambrands stock was unchanged at $41.75 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
